purpose: Teach: 軍曹/億万/而/擇/蝓/古賀/関口/渡邊

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、軍曹、つまり下士官の戦傷ケアの歴史を医療チームで学びます
lines.en: Ren, we'll be studying the history of combat wound care for NCOs with the medical team.
lines.style: Clear, steady clinical instruction. Even delivery. Professional but not cold — matter-of-fact assurance that this is routine team knowledge-building.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、億万円の保険適用の制度を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be researching insurance coverage systems for major medical procedures with the team.
lines.style: Same clinical tempo. Slightly longer pause before team projects — she's setting expectations. Direct eye contact level.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医学古典の「而」、つまり「而して」の用法を医療チームで紐解きます
lines.en: Ren, we'll be examining the classical medical texts and how classical conjunctions function within them as a team.
lines.style: Patient, measured. Slight lean forward on the technical term — she's checking if he's following. No condescension, just clarity.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字「擇」、つまり選を含む医薬古書を医療チームで保管します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be cataloguing old medical manuscripts that use archaic characters with the team.
lines.style: Steady rhythm. Brief pause after the task name — giving him a moment to absorb. Voice stays level, supportive.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、害虫、つまり蝓由来の感染リスクを医療チームで監視します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be monitoring infection risks from parasitic organisms with the medical team.
lines.style: Clinical precision. No hesitation — she trusts him with the terminology. Calm but attentive, like she's assessing his readiness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者古賀様のご症状を医療チームで継続観察します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be conducting ongoing observation of patient Koga's condition with the team.
lines.style: Warm undercarriage to the clinical tone. Patient's name spoken with care — this isn't just casework. Steady and thorough.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療相談関口氏と医療チームで連携します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be coordinating with our medical consultant Sekiguchi as part of the team effort.
lines.style: Slight shift — collaborative rather than directive. The name carries respect. She's emphasizing partnership here.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者渡邊様の旧字戸籍を医療チームで確認します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be verifying the old registry records for patient Watanabe with the team.
lines.style: Quiet conclusion. Slight closure at the end — this is the last task. Voice drops just slightly, marking the end of the briefing. Warm and present.
